shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -30; node --version; npm --version; git log --stat --oneline | head -20
cat .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -50; ls node_modules/.bin

(PORT=3123 node src/index.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 1 && cat /tmp/server.log curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home: %{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/ LOC=$(curl -s -i -X POST localhost:3123/books --data-urlencode "title=The Left Hand of Darkness" --data-urlencode "author=Ursula K. Le Guin" --data-urlencode "notes=Winter on Gethen. Loving it so far." | grep -i '^location' | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\r') echo "created: $LOC" curl -s -X POST localhost:3123/books --data-urlencode "title=Piranesi" --data-urlencode "author=Susanna Clarke" -o /dev/null curl -s localhost:3123$LOC | sed -n '/
/,/<\/main>/p' echo "--- home after finishing Left Hand ---" curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST localhost:3123$LOC/finish curl -s localhost:3123/ | sed -n '/
/,/Add a book/p' echo "--- restart ---" pkill -f "node src/index.js"; sleep 0.5 (PORT=3123 node src/index.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 1 curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o '[^<]*' pkill -f "node src/index.js" echo "--- data file ---"; cat data/books.json
PORT=3123 node src/index.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 & PID=$!; sleep 1 curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o '[^<]*' kill $PID echo "--- data file ---"; cat /workspace/data/books.json; ls /workspace/data
